title: VAT breakdown table in the order confirmation email
description:
Context: The confirmation email today lists totals only; customers opening expense claims ask support for the VAT split (~30 tickets/month tagged "vat"). The order API already returns per-item VAT rates and amounts (GET /orders/{id}), so this is email-template rendering only.
Reason: Recurring, quantified support demand; no backend change needed — order data is complete.
Scope: This story adds the VAT breakdown table to the confirmation email template. Out of scope: invoice PDF (separate story), credit notes.
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: Question: should the table also appear in the order-history page, or email only?

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: Answer: email only for now — the order-history page is out of scope (tracked separately).

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: Note: legal confirmed there is no mandated VAT layout for transactional email; the template team's standard table is fine.
